Stalk $ETHUSD via

 2x Long (Bullish Flag Continuation)

Yesterday's expansive price action >70% LoD at open degrade this idea from Focus down to Stalk mode. I am restarting my count for a minimum of 2 tighten print before Focus again.

Stalk 
$BE
 via 
$BEX
 2x Long (Relative Strength)

Another session of higher low print but price print remains expansive. Yesterday's print exceeded beyond 120% ATR before retracing back below 100% ATR (94%). I wont be surprise to see it pushing off from here but I will want to only execute this with prior compression. It's still too heavily loose.

Stalk 
$MGNI
 (PEG Delayed Reaction, Beneath 5 years Cup and Handle Pattern)

One of the few high RVOL performing names yesterday was 
$MGNI
. I wouldn't chase this yesterday at open even on hindsight, considering it was the only 2 
$IGV
 name that stick out along with 
$ORCL
. The catalyst for the move was a raised price target by BofA. If price stall and tightens, there's still a window of entry opportunity. Take a look at the weekly chart for its 5 years cup and handle pattern

Stalk 
$AXTI
 via 
$AXTX
 (Relative Strength)

This is actually a very diffcult name to hold on a trailing 10-MA if you don't get the execution near the alignment of 10/20/50 MA with high volume thrust. Current price action has relative strength and also with 10/20/50/150 all coming together right beneath is, while the sideway box range is remains below 100-MA. I am stalking for further sideway price print while MAs inch closer to price. Currently 1.9 x ATR% from 50-MA with relative strength.

Focus 
$UMAC
 (Mean Reversion Base)

Arrowed candle was the PEG (gap down) action on +50% EPS +687% Sales YoY. Price pushes to a gain of +42% before deflating back to current PEG candle range again. Last 3 weeks of price drift with low volume is morphing into a mini saucer base, recapturing its 10/20/50-MA in the process. Looking for 25% RVOL within 30mins of open for execution on ORH.

Stalk 
$HNGE
 (Need the tightening from relative strength)

Very chaotic price print after Sept 25 low RVOL move out of downtrend line. A low volume price expansive move can get faded very easily either intraday, or the immediate subsequent sessions as shown here. 
$HNGE
 remains in my stalk because of its relative strength

Bullish Ascending Triangle remains intact after another week. Monday was the higher low pivot from yesterday's close.


$NOK
 is still capable of drifting into the apex of the ascending triangle for another 3 weeks or so. Still in my stalk list. I don't remove names unless they violate the intended technical structure.

$SOXX

$LABX

$SOXL

$MU

Focus 
$PBF
 (PEG Delayed Reaction)

PEG was July 30th, +704% EPS +56% Sales YoY. Today is September 30th yet price still remains within that single PEG print range. Have 7 week ascending base and 2 weeks of contracting range within a symmetrical triangle pattern. I also like the relative strength, trading above all MA yet only 1 x ATR% from 50-MA.
